run_dataset_downloader: run the dataset downloader CLI with a CDN file and output folder to download ProjectARIA dataset sequences
run_dataset_downloader_all_types: run the dataset downloader with data types set to all to download every available data type
run_dataset_downloader_specific_sequence: run the dataset downloader with specific sequence names to download only selected sequences
run_dataset_downloader_overwrite: run the dataset downloader with the overwrite flag to redownload and overwrite previously downloaded sequences
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that defines CLI arguments for CDN file, output folder, data types, and sequence names
